bullets.text: In Tiruvallur, angry residents blocked roads at midnight due to continuous power cuts and complained that electricity board officials responded with indifference.
In Poonamallee, a 34-year-old woman named Nithyashree was killed when a private bus hit her two-wheeler while she was commuting to work.
In Velachery, heavy traffic congestion occurred as crowds of people gathered to purchase festival clothing ahead of the season.
Omran Healthcare launched its first manufacturing plant in Gummidipoondi to produce blood pressure monitoring devices.
A cyclonic storm is likely to form over the Bay of Bengal, bringing moderate rain to Chennai and surrounding coastal regions.
Residents in Tiruvallur raised safety concerns over damaged and missing concrete slabs on the Manavalanagar road over bridge.
Digital Bharat Nidhi, the Tamil Nadu government, and TANFINET signed the BharatNet agreement at Sanchar Bhawan.
The IT Ministry unveiled a handbook for secure AI data sharing to boost innovation and ensure safe data practices.
L&T began construction of a 52MW data centre in Chennai as part of India's intensifying artificial intelligence infrastructure race.
The TVK IT wing deleted a controversial AI-generated video featuring a manipulated voice and likeness of DMK leader M.K. Stalin.
The Indian Meteorological Department reported that a low-pressure area over the Bay of Bengal could intensify into a cyclone within 24 hours.

stories.snippet: வங்கக்கடலில் உருவாகியுள்ள காற்றழுத்தத் தாழ்வுப் பகுதி அடுத்த 24 மணி நேரத்தில் புயலாக வலுப்பெற வாய்ப்புள்ளதாக இந்திய வானிலை ஆய்வு மையம் தெரிவித்துள்ளது. இந்தப் புயல் உருவானால், அதற்கு இந்தியா பரிந்துரைத்துள்ள ‘முரசு’…
